rows.label: bf04230100_0010
rows.name: After that, Tora hid away in Torigo city.

rows.label: bf04230100_0020
rows.name:
Using the blueprints and ether furnace Dad entrusted
to me, I made Hana, mo.

rows.label: bf04230100_0030
rows.name:
Don't you have any idea
who the attackers were?

rows.label: bf04230100_0040
rows.name:
I don't know who they were, but they were
definitely after Kiku, mo.

rows.label: bf04230100_0050
rows.name:
If it was Kiku they were after, how'd
she end up here in the Empire?

rows.label: bf04230100_0060
rows.name:
It looked like there were
imperial soldiers after her...

rows.label: bf04230100_0070
rows.name:
I don't know, mo. There's one more thing
I understand even less, mo.

rows.label: bf04230100_0080
rows.name: What's that?

rows.label: bf04230100_0090
rows.name: When the lab was attacked, Kiku wasn't finished, mo.

rows.label: bf04230100_0100
rows.name: The only one who could finish her was Dad, mo...

rows.label: bf04230100_0110
rows.name: Which means...

rows.label: bf04230100_0120
rows.name: Does that mean Tora's father is still alive?

rows.label: bf04230100_0130
rows.name: Dad must've been captured by them...

rows.label: bf04230100_0140
rows.name: You there! Don't move!

rows.label: bf04230100_0150
rows.name: [ML:undisp ]！！

rows.label: bf04230100_0160
rows.name: Imperial soldiers...

rows.label: bf04230100_0170
rows.name: You!

rows.label: bf04230100_0180
rows.name:
It's been a while, Driver of
Heaven's Holy Grail.

rows.label: bf04230100_0190
rows.name:
Meleph-sama, she's the one. That
mechanical girl took down our squad!

rows.label: bf04230100_0200
rows.name: Huh? Wait a minute.

rows.label: bf04230100_0210
rows.name: How did you come to that conclusion?!

rows.label: bf04230100_0220
rows.name:
They probably mistook what Nee-sama did
for Hana's doing, mo.

rows.label: bf04230100_0230
rows.name: So...Rex, was it?

rows.label: bf04230100_0240
rows.name:
I'm disappointed. I never thought
you all were behind these incidents.

rows.label: bf04230100_0250
rows.name:
What do you mean, behind the incidents?
It wasn't us. You've got it wrong!
